mapper.select: -- 승인자 큐용 공고 승인 상태를 집계한다. SELECT CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE a.approval_status_code = 'REQUESTED' ) AS integer) AS requested_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE a.approval_status_code = 'REJECTED' ) AS integer) AS rejected_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE a.approval_status_code = 'APPROVED' ) AS integer) AS approved_count FROM announcements a

-- 승인자 큐용 파트너 검증 검토 상태를 집계한다. SELECT CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE pv.status_code = 'SUBMITTED' ) AS integer) AS submitted_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE pv.status_code = 'REVIEWING' ) AS integer) AS reviewing_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE pv.status_code = 'VERIFIED' ) AS integer) AS verified_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE pv.status_code = 'REJECTED' ) AS integer) AS rejected_count FROM partner_verifications pv

-- 승인자 큐용 매칭 검토 상태를 집계한다. SELECT CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE mc.status_code = 'REVIEW_REQUIRED' ) AS integer) AS review_required_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE mc.status_code = 'BLOCKED' ) AS integer) AS blocked_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE mc.status_code = 'PROGRESSED' ) AS integer) AS progressed_count FROM matching_cases mc

-- 승인자 큐용 신청 진행 결과 상태를 집계한다. SELECT CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE ap.status_code = 'WAITING_RESULT' ) AS integer) AS waiting_result_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE ap.status_code = 'APPROVED' ) AS integer) AS approved_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE ap.status_code = 'SUPPLEMENT_REQUESTED' ) AS integer) AS supplement_requested_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE ap.status_code = 'STOPPED' ) AS integer) AS stopped_count FROM application_progresses ap
